set.body:
Outcome: independently test whether relational descriptors capture organization that marginal feature histograms omit.

Scope: a small deterministic synthetic drawing generator, not a general stimulus optimizer. Produce pairs with matched orientation, contour length, and curvature summaries under a frozen specification, but different closure, connectivity, spatial continuation, or parallel-pair organization. State exactly which marginals match and which are intentionally allowed to differ. Include known junction topology, overlaps/self-crossings, disconnected components, near misses, and perturbation cases.

Acceptance:
- Verify marginal matching numerically through the public feature API and establish intended topology/relationships independently from the graph implementation.
- Freeze graph node/edge meanings, tolerance units, cycle/closure conventions, and feature-level expected results before descriptor implementation.
- Match any additional marginal (such as junction counts/types) only where the particular comparison claims to control it; do not overstate equivalence.
- Version generator settings, seeds, fixtures, tolerances, and negative controls. A generator is sufficient; do not depend on a nonexistent graph-aware designer.
- Keep graph work after Release B and outside both release gates.
set.title: Generate matched-marginal drawings and freeze graph descriptor tests
